# Carbon Energy Nexus

> A free daily publication at carbonenergynexus.com on where carbon, energy, water and capital meet: CO2 capture and storage, carbon markets and removals, energy policy, produced water and the water footprint of energy, project finance and research. Each edition sorts news by electrons (power), molecules (fuels), pore space (the subsurface) and water, tracks projects on a seven step ladder from announcement to operation, and says what each story means for investors, regulators, industry and founders. Facts are sourced and dated; stages and outlooks are labeled as our judgment. General information, not investment advice.

## Tools
- [Energy and carbon footprint calculator](https://carbonenergynexus.com/calculator.html): households and companies, EPA and EIA factors, transparent Nexus Score
- [Frameworks](https://carbonenergynexus.com/frameworks.html): how projects, policy and carbon claims are judged

## Today's edition
- [Congo will halt cobalt exports again from Nov 30 as prices slide and stockpiles build](https://carbonenergynexus.com/): November 24, 2026. 96,600 tonnes was Congo's 2026 cobalt export ceiling. From Nov 30 the quota gives way to a full suspension with no end date, as prices slide and inventories build, the regulator said.
- [Capital: Niron plans a $1.8 billion rare earth free magnet complex in Alabama as rare earth stocks rebound](https://carbonenergynexus.com/#money)
- [Water: Thailand moves to cut off mining chemicals to Myanmar as arsenic reaches its taps](https://carbonenergynexus.com/#world)
- [Projects: California offers up to $18 million for geothermal exploration and drilling](https://carbonenergynexus.com/#projects)
- [Markets: Canada opens a carbon removal buying program to 19 offers, but nothing is bought yet](https://carbonenergynexus.com/#removals)
- [Regulation: Negotiators say Saudi Arabia led resistance to fossil fuel wording at COP31](https://carbonenergynexus.com/#policy)
